import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the iris dataset
iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a pairplot with Seaborn to visualize relationships between features
sns.set(style="whitegrid")
pairplot = sns.pairplot(iris, hue='species', palette='Set2', diag_kind='kde')

# Add a title to the pairplot
pairplot.fig.suptitle("Iris Dataset Pairplot", y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
